arxiv-2011-11797.title: Single-particle steering and nonlocality: The consecutive Stern-Gerlach Experiments
arxiv-2011-11797.creator: E Benítez Rodríguez, E Piceno Martínez, L M Arévalo Aguilar
arxiv-2011-11797.description: Abstract Quantum nonlocality and quantum steering are fundamental correlations of quantum systems which can not be created using classical resources only. Nonlocality describes the ability to influence the possible results of measurements carried out in distant systems, in quantum steering Alice remotely steers Bob’s state.

arxiv-2108-03465.title: A k k -mer Based Approach for SARS-CoV-2 Variant Identification
arxiv-2108-03465.creator: Sarwan Ali, Bikram Sahoo, Naimat Ullah, Alexander Zelikovskiy, Murray Patterson, Imdadullah Khan ∗
arxiv-2108-03465.description: Abstract With the rapid spread of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) across the globe and its continuous mutation, it is of pivotal importance to design a system to identify different known (and unknown) variants of SARS-CoV-2. Identifying particular variants helps to understand and model their spread patterns, design effective mitigation strategies, and prevent future outbreaks.

arxiv-2204-05565.title: Constructing constant curvature metrics on Riemann surfaces with singularities 0 0 footnotetext: ∗ This work is supported by the National Science Foundation of Henan (Grant No.202300410047)
arxiv-2204-05565.creator: Zhiqiang Wei School of Mathematics and Statistics, Henan University, Kaifeng 475004, P.R. ChinaEmail: weizhiqiang15@mails.ucas.edu.cn
arxiv-2204-05565.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhiqiang Wei School of Mathematics and Statistics, Henan University, Kaifeng 475004, P.R. ChinaEmail: weizhiqiang15@mails.ucas.edu.cn. Abstract By constructing an ODE through a kind of meromorphic 1-forms, we will give an explicit construction of a kind of conformal metrics of constant curvature on Riemann surfaces with singularities. As an application, we will classify constant curvature one metrics on S^{2} with two conical singularities, which was first proved by Troyanov in [ 16 ] by using projective connection. Key words constant curvature metrics, conical singularities.

arxiv-2309-04294.title: Microscopic analysis of dipole electric and magnetic strengths in 156 Gd
arxiv-2309-04294.creator: V.O. Nesterenko, P.I. Vishnevskiy, P.-G. Reinhard, A. Repko and J. Kvasil
arxiv-2309-04294.description: Abstract The dipole electric ( E ​ 1 E1 ) and magnetic ( M ​ 1 M1 ) strengths in strongly deformed 156 Gd are investigated within a fully self-consistent Quasiparticle Random Phase Approximation (QRPA) with Skyrme forces SVbas, SLy6 and SG2.

arxiv-2404-05413.title: Search and study of young infrared stellar clusters
arxiv-2404-05413.creator: Naira Azatyan
arxiv-2404-05413.description: Abstract The main aim of this paper is to study both the Interstellar Medium (ISM) and the young stellar population in the three star-forming regions, namely IRAS 05137+3919, 05168+3634, and 19110+1045. The study of the ISM includes determination of the hydrogen column density (N(H 2 )) and dust temperature (T d ) in the regions using Modified blackbody fitting.

arxiv-2505-13397.title: Learning by solving differential equations
arxiv-2505-13397.creator: Benoit Dherin *, Michael Munn *, Hanna Mazzawi, Michael Wunder, Sourabh Medapati, Javier Gonzalvo
arxiv-2505-13397.description: Abstract Modern deep learning algorithms use variations of gradient descent as their main learning methods. Gradient descent can be understood as the simplest Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solver; namely, the Euler method applied to the gradient flow differential equation. Since Euler, many ODE solvers have been devised that follow the gradient flow equation more precisely and more stably.

arxiv-2510-11898.title: Lightweight CNN-Based Wi-Fi Intrusion Detection Using 2D Traffic Representations
arxiv-2510-11898.creator: Rayed Suhail Ahmad, Rehan Ahmad, Quamar Niyaz
arxiv-2510-11898.description: Abstract Wi-Fi networks are ubiquitous in both home and enterprise environments, serving as a primary medium for Internet access and forming the backbone of modern IoT ecosystems. However, their inherent vulnerabilities, combined with widespread adoption, create opportunities for malicious actors to gain unauthorized access or compromise sensitive data stored on connected devices.

pmc-10719372.title: Molecular mechanism of phospholipid transport at the bacterial outer membrane interface
pmc-10719372.creator: Jiang Yeow, Min Luo, Shu-Sin Chng
pmc-10719372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The outer membrane (OM) of Gram-negative bacteria is an asymmetric lipid bilayer with outer leaflet lipopolysaccharides and inner leaflet phospholipids (PLs). This unique lipid asymmetry renders the OM impermeable to external insults, including antibiotics and bile salts. To maintain this barrier, the OmpC-Mla system removes mislocalized PLs from the OM outer leaflet, and transports them to the inner membrane (IM); in the first step, the OmpC-MlaA complex transfers PLs to the periplasmic chaperone MlaC, but mechanistic details are lacking.

pmc-11486923.title: Increased freedom of head movement mitigates stress and bacterial load in the airways of horses during transport
pmc-11486923.creator: Yuji Takahashi, Hidekazu Niwa, Yusaku Ebisuda, Kazutaka Mukai, Toshinobu Yoshida, Sharanne Raidal, Barbara Padalino, Hajime Ohmura
pmc-11486923.description: IntroductionProtection of horse welfare during transport is crucial. The aim of this study was to determine the effect of head and neck restraint on behavior and airway bacteria.MethodsIn a randomized crossover study, six healthy Thoroughbreds were transported by road for 22 h in an individual bay with tight head restraint (50 cm short-rope) or loose head restraint (95 cm long-rope).

pmc-11596824.title: Characterization of Exopolysaccharides from Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PC715 and Their Antibiofilm Activity Against Hafnia alvei
pmc-11596824.creator: Xiqian Tan, Bingyu Ma, Xiaoqing Wang, Fangchao Cui, Xuepeng Li, Jianrong Li, Antonio Bevilacqua
pmc-11596824.description: Exopolysaccharides (EPSs) secreted by lactic acid bacteria have the potential to enhance human health by showing various biological functions. This study investigated the biological role and antibiofilm properties of EPS715, a new neutral EPS produced by pickled vegetables originating from Lactobacillus plantarum PC715. The results indicate that EPS715 is primarily composed of rhamnose, glucose, and mannose.

pmc-11624763.title: Outcomes for women with diabetes admitted for labour care to midwifery units in the UK: a national prospective cohort study and survey of practice using the UK Midwifery Study System (UKMidSS)
pmc-11624763.creator: Alessandra Morelli, Lisa Smith, Amar Karia, Amber Marshall, Rachel Plachcinski, Wendy Tyler, Rachel Rowe
pmc-11624763.description: ObjectivesTo describe outcomes in women admitted for labour care to midwifery units with gestational or pre-existing diabetes, compare outcomes with other women admitted to the same units and describe admission and care guidance in midwifery units typically admitting women with diabetes.DesignA national cohort study and a survey of practice.

pmc-12434864.title: Allergic rhinitis and behaviour problems in urban children aged 6 to 12 years and the mediating role of sleep disturbance
pmc-12434864.creator: Shiyin Yang, Jiaxin Yang, Jiawen Xu, Yuli Hu, Chenyang Li, Lingli Zhang, Li Shen, Haibo Ye, Huajun Xu, Feng Liu, Hongliang Yi, Shankai Yin, Jian Guan, Yupu Liu
pmc-12434864.description: BackgroundThe association between allergic rhinitis (AR) and behaviour problems (BPs) is still controversy. Furthermore, potential critical mediating role of sleep disturbance (SD) in their association has not been explored.MethodsA total of 18,316 children aged 6 to 12 (mean age 7.89 years, male: 53.1%) were recruited from 34 primary schools from Shanghai, China.

pmc-12516492.creator: Cuiyun Deng, Antoni Garcia-Molina, Aurelio Gómez-Cadenas, Vicente Vives-Peris, Rubén Alcázar, Albert Ferrer, Teresa Altabella
pmc-12516492.description: Free and glycosylated sterols play a central role in maintaining the structural integrity and proper functioning of the plasma membrane, which serves as the primary sensor of cold and initiates signaling cascades to mitigate chilling-induced damage. Here, we characterize the cold-response of tomato (Solanum lycopersicum cv.

pmc-13258054.title: Mid-Term Outcomes of a Next-Generation Modular Acetabular System in Primary and Revision Total Hip Arthroplasty
pmc-13258054.creator: Garrett Ruff, Laith Bahlouli, Anzar Sarfraz, Farouk Khury, Diren Arsoy, Claudette Lajam, Vinay K. Aggarwal
pmc-13258054.description: Background/Objectives: Total hip arthroplasty (THA) is a common orthopedic procedure, and with projected growth in both primary and revision surgical volumes, robust implant performance data is necessary to inform surgical decision-making. To ensure successful outcomes in primary THA (pTHA) and revision THA (rTHA), surgeons need versatile implant systems that can address patient-specific surgical challenges.

pmc-13300997.title: MRI investigations on the effects of pulsed field ablation via a 122-electrode spherical array catheter on pulmonary vein dimensions
pmc-13300997.creator: L Shenavai, H Kottkamp, C Antepara, G Natchkebia, R Traxel, B Schumacher
pmc-13300997.description: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) as a new and promising energy source for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is evolving rapidly given its fast and efficient energy delivery and its degree of preferentiality to myocardial tissue ablation.Within the PULSAR IDE trial, PVI using a novel 122-electrode spherical map-and-ablate catheter was investigated in patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (PAF).

pmc-13424477.title: Speaking fluency and critical thinking among Egyptian EFL business students: a mixed-methods study
pmc-13424477.creator: Israa Ismael, Xin Luo, Sen Li, Nasir Ali
pmc-13424477.description: The integration of speaking fluency (SF) and critical thinking (CT) is essential for effective academic and professional communication; however, these skills are often examined separately in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) research. Limited evidence exists regarding their interaction within Egyptian higher education, particularly in non-language faculties.

pmc-13551720.title: Community perceptions, trust, and experiences of malaria clinical research and participation in rural Cambodia
pmc-13551720.creator: Bipin Adhikari, Lek Dysoley, Mom Ean, Hem Vattanak, Ung Soviet, Abhijit Mishra, Sarah Cassidy-Seyoum, Elke Wynberg, Rupam Tripura, Kamala Thriemer, Cindy S. Chu, Nicholas P. J. Day, Lorenz von Seidlein, Arjen M. Dondorp, Thomas J. Peto, Phaik Yeong Cheah
pmc-13551720.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionUnderstanding community perspectives on malaria treatment and research participation is important for designing ethically appropriate community engagement strategies, strengthening informed consent, and improving the conduct of clinical research while supporting disease control. This study explores treatment-seeking behaviours, perceptions of malaria, and experiences of research participation among community members in the catchment area of a rural research clinic run by the Mahidol-Oxford Tropical Medicine Research Unit (MORU) in Siem Pang district, Cambodia.MethodsThis qualitative study was conducted between July and September 2025.
